name: selector-parent
witness: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM bim_clash_a a LEFT JOIN bim_clash_set s ON a.clash_set_id=s.id WHERE s.id IS NULL

name: selector-ordinal
sql: UPDATE bim_clash_a_class SET ordinal=99 WHERE ordinal=0
witness: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM (SELECT clash_a_id FROM bim_clash_a_class GROUP BY clash_a_id HAVING min(ordinal)<>0 OR max(ordinal)<>count(*)-1)

name: scope-parent
witness: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM bim_rule_scope a LEFT JOIN bim_rule s ON a.rule_id=s.id WHERE s.id IS NULL

name: viewpoint-parent
witness: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM bim_issue_viewpoint a LEFT JOIN bim_issue s ON a.issue_id=s.id WHERE s.id IS NULL

name: path-ordinal
sql: UPDATE bim_mep_path SET ordinal=99 WHERE ordinal=0 AND mep_element_id=(SELECT id FROM bim_mep_element WHERE map_key='mep/duct')
witness: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM (SELECT mep_element_id FROM bim_mep_path GROUP BY mep_element_id HAVING min(ordinal)<>0 OR max(ordinal)<>count(*)-1)

name: inactive-shape
witness: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM bim_mep_element WHERE shape_kind IN('Duct','Tray') AND diameter_bits IS NOT NULL
